title: Numbered shopping list
description: Print the items of a list, one per line, each prefixed with its position counted from 1, a dot and a single space (for example `1. milk`). Items are printed in order exactly as given, even when an item is empty. Return how many items were printed. An empty list prints nothing and returns 0.
notes: Level 1. Position numbers go past 9 (two digits, no padding); empty and blank items keep their line; trailing space after the dot stays when the item is empty.
